outlook: In overnight trade Monday (about 7:45 a.m. CT), January soybeans were down 4¼ cents at $12.30, still near recent lows as funds keep selling, while December corn was up 1¼ cents at $4.49 after USDA announced a 1.73 million-tonne corn sale to Mexico. December Minneapolis spring wheat gained 2½ cents to $6.26¼ and December Chicago wheat rose a penny to $6.04½. January canola fell C$5.90 to C$782.10 as crude oil dropped sharply on hopes for a U.S.–Iran deal. Friday's CFTC data showed funds cut large net long positions in corn and soybeans; prices are overnight levels, not closes, and cash bids are from Friday's USDA Minneapolis report.
